maria_marketing: Quick sync  eu-west embeddings had a ~30m window of intermittent 5xxs earlier. Tom routed to a fallback. Need short statuspage copy + decision on customer webinar vs. targeted 1:1 outreach.

Tom_oncall: Confirmed. Mitigation = fallback model `embed-compat-v1` at ~18:40 UTC; rollback to stable runtime in progress. Canary looks good so far. No user data exposed.

kevin_csm: We have 10 affected orgs, 3 with high volume. Theyll want transparency; recommend invite-only technical briefing for top customers and a concise status email to all impacted.

maria_marketing: Draft statuspage text (short):
"Embeddings (eu-west): degraded performance. A subset of requests returned errors or experienced higher latency. Traffic has been routed to a fallback model while a fix is validated. No data loss detected."

asha_prod: Wording good. Add "ETA: under validation; updates to follow." Also prepare an FAQ blurb for support.

kevin_csm: For webinar, keep it 30m tech + 15m office hours. Invite top 3, offer 1:1s to others. Offer a small service credit for orgs with >2% error rate. I'll confirm list and coordinate legal/finance.

maria_marketing: Timing plan: post degraded now, prep targeted email (staged), invite-only webinar draft, and canned support replies. If fix not done within 2h, send interim email.
